title: Key inequality r < −Dd(x)[x − ξ] near the boundary of a convex set (Simon 2.8 (1), C2)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝⁿ open and convex with Uᶜ nonempty, ξ ∈ ℝⁿ and r > 0 with closedBall(ξ, r) ⊆ U, and d(y) := infDist(y, Uᶜ). Then there is η > 0 such that for every x ∈ U with d(x) < η at which d is differentiable, r < −Dd(x)[x − ξ] (Dd = fderiv ℝ d).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (ξ : Rn n) (r : ℝ), IsOpen U → Convex ℝ U → Uᶜ.Nonempty → 0 < r → closedBall ξ r ⊆ U → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, infDist x Uᶜ < η → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y ↦ infDist y Uᶜ) x → r < -fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ infDist y Uᶜ) x (x - ξ)
